entry.description: SetScriptState 0x445740 always completes. Only a first-call invocation scans tokens. The default actor is creature+0xd0. Within each argument, character= is checked before set= and state=, case-insensitively as a substring. Last recognized values win. A character token invokes global callback 0x923904 when present, replacing the current target even when the callback returns null; without that callback, the prior/default target is retained.

set.description: set= is evaluated through numeric helper 0x5147c0, then truncated toward zero. Integers outside 0..16 become zero. Zero selects the self/named-target path; values 1..16 select every matching group actor. The group path is independent of the named target. Thus set=17, set=-1 and set=0.9 all use the default/named target, while set=2.99 chooses group 2.

actors.description: Group iteration uses global array 0x93d504 with count 0x93d500 and stride 0x10d8. Actor flags at +0x1fc must contain both 1 and 0x1000, and byte+0x378 must equal the selected group. Each actor stores its script packet at +4. The self/named path checks actor, packet and base script for null; the selected group path dereferences packet/base script without those checks.

binding.description: Look up the target state in packet.BaseScript, not the current referenced script. Lookup takes the first case-insensitive name match. A missing state does nothing. A match clears reference depth to zero and immediately calls original binder 0x514640 with the base script, target state and no character configuration. This reloads all four script-default parameters, selects the target first action, clears pending/blocked/timed-state fields, and keeps the packet timer. Character tuning overrides are not used by this command.

timing.description: Immediate rebind can execute the new first action during the same 0x52cc90 update when the command targets its own packet. A native chain using SetScriptState then target ResetTimer confirms this. A different actor is rebound immediately but its target action executes when that actor is subsequently updated; the command does not directly run another actor scheduler.

adapters.scope: Fixture callback maps supplied names to an existing actor pointer or null. Character/alias resolution policy is not recovered here.

portable.status: Core and comparison harness compile with installed C# 5 compiler. Managed execution/differential comparison pending because Windows denies new managed executables.
adapters: StateControlContext.Self/Actors are a host projection of creature weak reference and native world object registry.
ResolveCharacter is the explicit native 0x923904 callback boundary; player aliases, dynamic names and character attachment are not invented.
ScriptMachine.Bind supplies the previously reconstructed state binding and explicit condition-bank/script-bound adapters.
hostGuards: Reject nonfinite or int32-overflow group conversion inputs outside native fixture domain.
Reject selected group actors without a packet/base script instead of reproducing an invalid dereference.

sourceQualification: Matching state names are lexical candidates across shipped scripts, not proof that a selected runtime character has that base script. Native fixtures intentionally supply resolved script lists and test binding behavior.
remaining: Synthetically resolved script/state lists, not runtime source attachment or whole-level reachability.
Selected group records are required to have a valid packet and base-script pointer; original group path lacks the self-path null checks.
Numeric group fixtures are finite values within int32 conversion range; NaN/infinity/overflow are excluded.
Compiled C# differential execution remains pending.
